# Try mask cells; count local 9 / nonzero, offset shifts -3..3. Report best precision/recall exact incl boundary out-of-bounds as 0.
def test_mask(grid_in,grid_out,mask, rad=5):
  y=grid_out==7; v=grid_in==0
  res=[]
  for dr0 in range(-rad,rad+1):
   for dc0 in range(-rad,rad+1):
    for use_nonzero in [False,True]:
     z=np.zeros(grid_in.shape,dtype=int)
     for ro,co in mask:
      rr=np.arange(grid_in.shape[0])[:,None]+dr0+ro
      cc=np.arange(grid_in.shape[1])[None,:]+dc0+co
      valid_idx=(rr>=0)&(rr<grid_in.shape[0])&(cc>=0)&(cc<grid_in.shape[1])
      sampled=np.zeros(grid_in.shape,dtype=int)
      sampled[valid_idx]=((grid_in[rr[valid_idx],cc[valid_idx]]!=0) if use_nonzero else (grid_in[rr[valid_idx],cc[valid_idx]==9]))

     pred=(z%2==1)&v
     tp=(pred&y).sum(); fp=(pred&~y&v).sum(); fn=(~pred&y&v).sum()
     acc=(tp+((~pred)&(~y)&v).sum())/v.sum()
     if fp+fn==0: print('EXACT!',dr0,dc0,use_nonzero)
     res.append((acc,tp,fp,fn,dr0,dc0,use_nonzero))
  return sorted(res,reverse=True)

def gf2_solve(F,y):
 M=np.concatenate([F.astype(np.uint8)%2,y.astype(np.uint8)[:,None]],axis=1).copy(); m,n=M.shape; piv=[]; row=0
 for col in range(n-1):
  cand=np.where(M[row:,col])[0]
  if not len(cand): continue
  pr=row+cand[0]; M[[row,pr]]=M[[pr,row]]
  for rr in range(m):
   if rr!=row and M[rr,col]: M[rr]^=M[row]
  piv.append(col); row+=1
  if row==m: break
 inconsistent=any(M[i,:n-1].sum()==0 and M[i,n-1] for i in range(m))
 x=np.zeros(n-1,dtype=np.uint8)
 if not inconsistent:
  for i,col in enumerate(piv): x[col]=M[i,n-1]
 return inconsistent,x,len(piv)
for rad in [1,2,3,4]:
 offs=[(dr,dc) for dr in range(-rad,rad+1) for dc in range(-rad,rad+1) if (dr,dc)!=(0,0)]
 pts=[(r,c) for r,c in zip(*np.where(X==0)) if (r<14 or c<22 or c>27 or r>19)]
 FF=np.array([[int(0<=r+dr<R and 0<=c+dc<C and X[r+dr,c+dc]==5) for dr,dc in offs] for r,c in pts],dtype=np.uint8)
 ll=np.array([int(Y[r,c]==3) for r,c in pts],dtype=np.uint8)
 inc,coef,rank=gf2_solve(FF,ll)
 print(rad,FF.shape,'inconsistent',inc,'rank',rank,'ones',int(coef.sum()))
